subtopics.label: Pancreatic Cancer Biology and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms, oncogenic drivers (KRAS, p53, NADK, RHAMM), tumor microenvironment, and therapeutic strategies in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, including surgical outcomes and systemic therapy trials.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular drivers, tumor microenvironment, and therapeutic strategies in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine tumors.

subtopics.label: Gastric and Gastroesophageal Cancer Systemic Therapy and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and biomarker studies in gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and esophageal adenocarcinoma, including targeted agents (zolbetuximab, ramucirumab, andecaliximab), immunotherapy, CLDN18.2, FGFR2, HER2, and TP53 mutation stratification.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical trials and biomarker studies in gastric and gastroesophageal cancers, including HER2, CLDN18.2, and FGFR2-targeted agents.

subtopics.label: Esophageal Cancer Surgery and Multimodal Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical approaches, lymphadenectomy, neoadjuvant chemoradiation, and survival outcomes in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma, including robotic esophagectomy and immunotherapy biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical approaches, neoadjuvant chemoradiation, and survival outcomes in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Molecular Biology and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms driving colorectal cancer initiation and progression, including Wnt/APC signaling, PKCλ/ι, aPKC, SOX17, ILC3 dysregulation, immune evasion, lineage plasticity, and tumor microenvironment characterization.
subtopics.short_description: Wnt signaling, immune evasion, lineage plasticity, and tumor microenvironment characterization in colorectal cancer.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Endoscopic and Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Studies on endoscopic resection techniques (ESD, EMR, cold snare polypectomy, FTRD), minimally invasive and robotic colorectal surgery, colonic stenting, and perioperative outcomes for colorectal cancer and polyps.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic resection techniques, robotic colorectal surgery, and perioperative outcomes for colorectal cancer and polyps.

subtopics.label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Cholangiocarcinoma Biology and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on molecular pathogenesis, imaging, locoregional therapies (Y-90 radioembolization, TACE), surgical approaches, and biomarkers in hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, including PKCλ/ι, STING pathway, and IDH1/2 mutations.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathogenesis, imaging, and locoregional and surgical treatments for hepatocellular carcinoma and cholangiocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Pretargeted Radioimmunotherapy and Targeted Drug Delivery in GI Cancers
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of pretargeted radioimmunotherapy (GPA33, HER2 targeting), antibody-drug conjugates, nanoparticle drug delivery systems, and novel radiohaptens for colorectal, gastric, and other GI cancers.
subtopics.short_description: Pretargeted radioimmunotherapy, antibody-drug conjugates, and nanoparticle delivery systems for GI cancers.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Screening, Disparities, and Lynch Syndrome
subtopics.description: Studies on colorectal cancer screening uptake, racial and socioeconomic disparities, Lynch syndrome identification and surveillance, hereditary cancer risk assessment, and factors influencing screening receipt.
subtopics.short_description: Colorectal cancer screening uptake, racial and socioeconomic disparities, and Lynch syndrome surveillance and risk assessment.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Cystic Lesions, Biliary Tract, and Ampullary Neoplasms
subtopics.description: Diagnostic and pathological studies of pancreatic cystic neoplasms, biliary tract adenocarcinomas, ampullary adenocarcinoma, intracholecystic papillary neoplasms, and EUS-guided tissue acquisition and biliary drainage.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and pathology of pancreatic cystic lesions, biliary tract adenocarcinomas, and ampullary neoplasms.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment, Immunotherapy Resistance, and Immune Modulation in GI Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on immune cell interactions, immunotherapy resistance mechanisms, and novel immune-modulating strategies in GI cancers, including TGFβ inhibition, MEK inhibition with GITR costimulation, PKCλ/ι-mediated interferon response, and neutrophil-driven resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell interactions, immunotherapy resistance mechanisms, and novel immune-modulating strategies in GI cancers.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, ctDNA, and Molecular Diagnostics in GI Cancers
subtopics.description: Studies on circulating tumor DNA detection, next-generation sequencing of plasma and tissue, methylation markers, and molecular biomarker testing for diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment selection in GI and other solid tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA detection, next-generation sequencing, and methylation markers for GI cancer diagnosis and monitoring.

subtopics.label: Gastrointestinal Neuroendocrine and Stromal Tumors
subtopics.description: Clinical and molecular studies of gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors (colorectal, pancreatic) and gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including surgical timing, recurrence predictors, novel gene fusions, and endoscopic resection.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and molecular studies of GI neuroendocrine tumors and stromal tumors, including novel gene fusions and surgical timing.

subtopics.label: Rectal Cancer Treatment, Staging, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on rectal cancer management including neoadjuvant chemoradiation, surgical outcomes, MRI-based response assessment, care fragmentation, Medicaid expansion impact, and staging reproducibility.
subtopics.short_description: Neoadjuvant chemoradiation, surgical outcomes, MRI-based response assessment, and care fragmentation in rectal cancer.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Cancer Models, Epigenetics, and Tumor Initiation
subtopics.description: Development and use of preclinical models (mouse, organoid, xenograft) and epigenetic studies to investigate GI cancer initiation, lineage plasticity, chromatin remodeling, and oncogenic mutation modeling.
subtopics.short_description: Mouse, organoid, and xenograft models and epigenetic studies of GI cancer initiation, chromatin remodeling, and lineage plasticity.

subtopics.label: Extracellular Vesicles in Cancer Metastasis and Systemic Effects
subtopics.description: Research on tumor-derived extracellular vesicles and particles that drive metastatic progression, cancer-associated thrombosis, liver metabolic dysfunction, and antitumor immune priming via Kupffer cells.
subtopics.short_description: Tumor-derived extracellular vesicles driving metastasis, cancer-associated thrombosis, and antitumor immune priming.

subtopics.label: Cancer Care Disparities, Access, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Studies examining racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cancer screening adherence, surgical access (robot-assisted and minimally invasive surgery), health literacy, and care utilization across cancer populations.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cancer screening, surgical access, and care utilization across cancer populations.

subtopics.label: Comorbidity Management and Survivorship in Cancer Patients
subtopics.description: Investigations into the management of chronic comorbidities such as diabetes and cardiovascular disease before and after cancer diagnosis, including racial disparities in comorbidity care among cancer survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Chronic comorbidity care — including diabetes and cardiovascular disease — before and after cancer diagnosis, with attention to racial disparities.

subtopics.label: Liver Transplantation, Viral Hepatitis, and Obesity
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on liver transplantation outcomes in the context of viral hepatitis (HCV, HDV, HBV) and obesity, including epidemiology of HCV in high-prevalence regions and management challenges in obese transplant candidates.
subtopics.short_description: Transplantation outcomes in the context of HCV, HBV, and HDV infection, and management challenges in obese transplant candidates.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics, Structural Variation, and Clonal Hematopoiesis
subtopics.description: Pan-cancer genomic analyses uncovering complex structural rearrangements across cancer genomes and the association of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) and mosaic chromosomal alterations with solid tumor incidence and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Pan-cancer genomic analyses of structural rearrangements and clonal hematopoiesis associations with solid tumor incidence and mortality.

subtopics.label: Cancer Treatment Timing, Regionalization, and Surgical Quality
subtopics.description: Research on the impact of treatment delays on tumor control and metastatic risk, and systematic evidence on regionalization of surgical oncology care to improve patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of treatment delays on tumor control and evidence for regionalizing surgical oncology care to improve outcomes.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Immune Enhancement in Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on pharmacologic and metabolic interventions—including LDH inhibition and tumor extracellular vesicle signaling—that redirect glucose metabolism and enhance antitumor T cell immunity in solid tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacologic and metabolic interventions that redirect glucose metabolism and enhance antitumor T cell responses in solid tumors.

subtopics.label: Systemic Therapy Resistance and Novel Agents in Colorectal and Gastric Cancer
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational studies on resistance mechanisms and novel therapeutic strategies in colorectal and gastric cancers, including taxane resistance in gastric cancer, napabucasin plus FOLFIRI in metastatic colorectal cancer, and HER2 testing practices.
subtopics.short_description: Resistance mechanisms and novel therapeutic strategies in colorectal and gastric cancers, including taxane and FOLFIRI-based regimens.
